definitions.explanation: The reddish-brown coating that forms on iron or steel when exposed to moisture and air.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}のチェーンに{錆|さび}がついている。
examples.english: There's rust on the bicycle chain.

examples.japanese: {錆|さび}を{落|お}とすのは{大変|たいへん}だ。
{雨|あめ}ざらしにすると{錆|さび}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: If you leave it exposed to rain, it will rust.

notes:
{錆|さび} refers to the oxidation that forms on metal, particularly iron and steel.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {錆|さび}がつく (to become rusty)
- {錆|さび}が{出|で}る (rust appears)
- {錆|さび}を{落|お}とす (to remove rust)
- {錆|さび}{止|ど}め (rust prevention)
- {錆|さび}びる (to rust) [verb form]

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {赤錆|あかさび} (red rust)
- {青錆|あおさび} (verdigris, green rust on copper)
